home.title: Welcome
home.welcomeDefault: Welcome to the residents' page of our community.

register.title: Registration application
register.intro: Fill in the form. An administrator checks it, then you activate your account in the Telegram bot.
register.consent: I agree that my data is stored to check that I live here
register.unavailable: Registration is not open yet. Please try again later.
register.doneText: After an administrator approves it, open the bot and share your phone number. Then you can log in.
register.qrHint: Scan with your phone if you are on a computer

login.title: Log in
login.codeSent: If this number has access, a code was sent to your Telegram. Enter it below.

applications.title: Applications
applications.hint: Open a person to correct the details before approving.

user.phoneLocked: Unlink Telegram to change the phone of an activated user.
user.disableConfirm: Disable {{name}}? They will be logged out and cannot log in until enabled.
user.noChannels: No messenger is linked yet. The person activates the account by sharing their phone in the bot.
user.unlinkHint: The user goes back to awaiting activation and must share the phone in the bot again.
user.notResidentHint: The Resident flag is off: these apartments are kept but ignored.

houses.title: Houses
houses.empty: No houses yet. Add the houses of your community to open registration.

house.name: Name
house.nameHint: As residents know it, e.g. "12" or "7, section 1"
house.archivedHint: An archived house is hidden from registration.

statuses.title: Residency statuses
statuses.codeHint: Latin letters, digits and _; cannot be changed later
statuses.name: Name

site.title: Site
site.noPicture: No picture is uploaded: residents see this illustration drawn from the houses.
site.pictureHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB
site.removePictureConfirm: Remove the picture? Residents will see the built-in illustration.

invite.title: Invite residents
invite.hint: Pin this link in the community chat or print the QR code. Residents apply with it; you approve each application.

errors.bad_request: The request could not be understood. Reload the page and try again.
errors.conflict: This action is not possible in the current state.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this.
errors.last_admin: This is the last active administrator: they cannot lose admin rights or be disabled.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.try_later: Too many applications are waiting right now. Please try again later.
errors.invalid_code: The code is wrong or has expired.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Please try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

validation.linked: Unlink the messenger first to change the phone
validation.has_residents: Residents are registered in apartments outside this range
validation.type: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP images
validation.size: The file is larger than 5 MB
